name: Node.js Atomic CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  # Atomic deployment is 100% safe to cancel anytime, so we can turn this ON for all branches!
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build (CI)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup pnpm
      uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
      with:
        version: 10.33.0

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '22.22.3'
        cache: 'pnpm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

    - name: Run ESLint
      run: pnpm run lint

    - name: Build Project
      run: pnpm run build

  deploy:
    name: Atomic Deploy to AWS EC2 (CD)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: build 
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    
    steps:
    - name: Atomic Deploy to AWS via SSH
      uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.0.3
      with:
        host: ${{ secrets.AWS_HOST }}
        username: ${{ secrets.AWS_USERNAME }}
        key: ${{ secrets.AWS_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        port: 22
        script_stop: true 
        script: |
          # ==========================================
          # ATOMIC DEPLOYMENT SCRIPT
          # ==========================================
          
          # 1. Define Variables
          BASE_DIR="/home/ubuntu/apps"
          APP_NAME="poolpay-api"
          RELEASES_DIR="$BASE_DIR/${APP_NAME}-releases"
          SHARED_DIR="$BASE_DIR/${APP_NAME}-shared"
          CURRENT_DIR="$BASE_DIR/${APP_NAME}"
          
          # Use GitHub commit ID to create a unique folder name
          NEW_RELEASE_DIR="$RELEASES_DIR/${{ github.sha }}"
          
          # 2. Create required directories if they don't exist
          mkdir -p $RELEASES_DIR
          mkdir -p $SHARED_DIR/uploads
          
          # 3. Clone the new code into the completely isolated temporary folder
          echo "🚀 Cloning new release into $NEW_RELEASE_DIR..."
          git clone https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git $NEW_RELEASE_DIR
          cd $NEW_RELEASE_DIR
          
          # 4. Copy the .env file and link the uploads folder from the shared folder
          # ⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST manually create the .env file inside /home/ubuntu/apps/poolpay-api-shared/ once!
          echo "📂 Copying shared environment variables..."
          cp $SHARED_DIR/.env $NEW_RELEASE_DIR/.env || echo "Warning: No .env found in shared directory"
          
          echo "🔗 Linking shared uploads folder..."
          # If you have an uploads folder for user images, it MUST be linked so they don't get deleted
          rm -rf $NEW_RELEASE_DIR/uploads
          ln -sfn $SHARED_DIR/uploads $NEW_RELEASE_DIR/uploads
          
          # 5. Install dependencies and Build inside the NEW folder
          echo "📦 Installing packages and building..."
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          pnpm run build
          
          # 6. Swap the Symlink (This is the MAGIC step - Zero Downtime & 100% Safe)
          # Only runs if step 5 is fully successful. It replaces the live folder with the new one.
          echo "🔄 Swapping symlink to new release..."
          ln -sfn $NEW_RELEASE_DIR $CURRENT_DIR
          
          # 7. Clean up old releases (Keep only the latest 3 to save Hard Disk space)
          echo "🧹 Cleaning up old releases..."
          cd $RELEASES_DIR
          ls -t | tail -n +4 | xargs -r rm -rf
          
          # 8. Reload PM2
          echo "⚡ Reloading PM2..."
          pm2 reload poolpay-api
